product: AVISO updated merged absolute surface geostrophic velocity; ADT = SLA + MDT
boundary_definition: P-Q distance normal to the jet axis, bounded by the 0.1 m/s along-stream cut-off; Figure 2.
averaging_order: Stream-coordinate diagnostics including section width calculated every 7 days, then temporal and along-stream summaries; not width diagnosed from a seasonal mean velocity field.
spatial_scope: East China Sea mainstream, East Taiwan Strait toward Tokara Strait; study along-stream analysis between 122 and 130 E. Does not include the entire Luzon-to-Japan Kuroshio or Kuroshio Extension.
source_quality_note: Weekly averaged and smoothed surface geostrophic product; ageostrophic flow is not included in the width diagnosis. Interpolation to 0.1 degree does not add independent observation resolution. Exact spatial/temporal weighting and season-to-month convention remain unresolved.
